productConcept.name: Draftform
productConcept.description: AI hardware design IDE — users describe what they want to build in natural language and receive production-ready STL files, DXF drawings, and PCB layouts, with an interface that adapts dynamically to what is being rendered.
productConcept.rationale: The Pale Draft design system's warm ivory (#fcf7f1) background, EB Garamond italic headings, and Overpass Mono technical type evoke premium engineering documentation — the aesthetic of precision instruments and well-made engineering artifacts. A hardware design IDE sits at the intersection of technical authority and design quality, which this system was built to express. The brand name Draftform is a portmanteau of 'draft' (engineering drawing) and 'form' (3D geometry) — precise without being clinical.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion.json has hasHeroVideo:true, named easing curves (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)), fadeIn/fadeInUp/fadeInLeft keyframe definitions, and concept_by_video.md describes scroll-triggered reveal patterns. First condition override applied.
